images.title: Split the bar into 2 + 3 groups
images.purpose: Shows the ratio sharer in its simplest state: ₹4500 cut into 5 equal groups of 900, two for one part and three for the other.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One long bar across the middle split into five equal boxes, with the whole above and the two parts below.
images.exact_structure: One horizontal bar with a dark outline and a brace over its whole length labelled ₹4500. The bar is split into exactly 5 equal boxes: boxes 1 and 2 filled teal (#0072B2), boxes 3 to 5 filled amber (#E69F00). A small reddish purple (#CC79A7) brace over box 1 only, inside the big brace, labelled 900. Under boxes 1 and 2, a teal brace labelled ₹1800; under boxes 3 to 5, an amber brace labelled ₹2700. At the left of the bar: 2 : 3. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Add the terms for the number of groups, divide for one group, then multiply by each term.

image_decisions.why: The tool's core action, cutting a bar into m + n groups and colouring m and n, in its plainest state.
